items.title: U.S. and allies display growing naval cooperation in Pacific drills
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. and its allies conducted their largest Rim of the Pacific maritime exercise to date, demonstrating deepening military cooperation amid concerns about China and North Korea, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: L3Harris (LHX) Lands Seven Year Missile Propulsion Deals For PAC 3 And THAAD
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) has signed multi year propulsion agreements with the Department of War and Lockheed Martin. The contracts cover missile propulsion production for the PAC 3 MSE and THAAD defense systems. The agreements are described as transformative and are intended to nearly triple and quadruple propulsion output for these programs. items.title: Houthis deny Red Sea fee plan as Trump prepares new Iran strikes
items.summary: Investing.com -- Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis denied on Saturday that they planned to charge commercial ships passing through the Bab el-Mandeb strait, as the U.S. prepared for a new attack on Iran that could begin this weekend.
